programme.name: AB-Cloud Research Programme

programme.one_line: One study in four levels: the algebraic AB (Aharonov-Bohm) architecture as a computing fabric, its Dirac skeleton, the Hilbert-Pólya bridge, and the blind verification apparatus.

honest_boundary.statement: Everything in this package is a numerical and formal study of a mathematical model. It does NOT prove the Riemann hypothesis. The V13 obligation machine keeps the RH conclusion blocked (verdict: blocked) while the analytic prerequisites remain assumed.
